quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Prices you've offered and what customers decided.
quotes.newDescription: Lines from your catalog and services, a discount, tax per line and a validity date.
quotes.emptyHint: Create a quote and send it to a customer to approve.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: What you've billed, what's been paid and what's still open.
invoices.newDescription: A blank invoice for a customer. To bill a job, start from the job.
invoices.newForJob: Lines from {job}: the service, recorded labor and approved parts. Review them before saving.
invoices.newForJobFromQuote: Lines from {job} and its approved quote {quote}, with recorded labor and approved parts. Review them before saving.
invoices.jobNotCompletedHint: Invoice a job once the work is done.
invoices.emptyHint: Invoice a completed job from its page, or create a blank invoice for a customer.

quote.sendDescription: The customer gets an email with a link to view and approve the quote.
quote.noEmailContacts: No contact with an email address
quote.decisionDescription: Record what the customer told you by phone or in person.
quote.approveHint: Approving creates a new job for this customer and site, ready to schedule.
quote.revised: The quote is a draft again. Send it once you're done.

invoice.issueDescription: The invoice gets the next number, today's date and a due date after your payment terms, and the customer gets it by email.
invoice.sendDescription: The customer gets the invoice by email again, with a link to view it.
invoice.noEmailContacts: No contact with an email address
invoice.paymentDescription: A payment by bank transfer, cash or a card taken elsewhere. It can't be more than the balance.
invoice.dateInvalid: Choose a date up to today
invoice.paidInFull: Payment recorded. The invoice is paid.
invoice.voidDescription: A void invoice stays on record with its number but no longer counts as owed. Its parts and expenses can be billed again.
invoice.voidReasonRequired: Say why the invoice is void

lines.title: Lines
lines.caption: Lines with quantity, price, tax and amount
lines.fromExpense: An approved part or expense: billed at cost plus markup, {price} each.
lines.empty: No lines yet. Add a part or fee from the catalog, a service or a free line.
lines.invalidDiscount: Enter a percentage up to 100 or a valid amount

form.title: Title
form.serviceTypeHint: Used for the job an approval creates: its checklist and duration.
form.notesHint: Shown on the quote, e.g. what's included or a warranty.
form.number: Enter a quantity above zero (two decimals at most)

job.title: Billing
job.invoiceWhenCompleted: The job can be invoiced once it's completed.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Parts and fees you put on quotes and invoices. Services and their prices are the service types.
catalog.emptyHint: Add the parts you sell and fees such as a call-out charge.
catalog.name: Name

settings.termsDescription: Due dates, quote validity and the hourly rate for recorded work time.
settings.paymentTermsHint: An invoice is due this many days after it's issued.
settings.quoteValidityHint: New quotes are valid this long unless you set a date.
settings.laborRateHint: Recorded work time is billed per technician, rounded up to the quarter hour.
settings.numberingDescription: Numbers restart every year and have no gaps. Invoices get theirs when they're issued.
settings.paymentInstructionsHint: Printed on invoices and in invoice emails, e.g. your bank details.
settings.remindersHint: Emails the bill-to contact 3, 7 and 14 days after the due date while a balance is open.

serviceType.taxHint: Used when the service is put on a quote or invoice.

dashboard.title: Revenue
dashboard.invoicedNote: {count, plural, one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}
dashboard.chartDescription: Invoiced and collected per {bucket, select, week {week} other {day}}.
dashboard.downloadCsvLabel: Download the revenue trend as CSV
